_comment: IAM role for EventBridge Scheduler to invoke ECS RunTask.
Two documents: (1) trust policy — lets the Scheduler service assume this role;
(2) permissions — lets the assumed role call ecs:RunTask on the backend task
definition and iam:PassRole for both the task role and the execution role,
which ECS requires at launch time.
This file is the TRUST policy (--assume-role-policy-document).
The inline permissions policy is embedded below under '_permissions' for
reference; extract it into a separate file or use put-role-policy inline.

_permissions._comment: Inline permissions policy for the scheduler role. Apply via put-role-policy.
